request.prompt:
Goods: Split air conditioner 12000 BTU
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 84 Machinery and mechanical appliances, boilers, nuclear reactors; parts thereof

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 8415: Air conditioning machines; comprising a motor driven fan and elements for changing the temperature and humidity, including those machines in which the humidity cannot be separately regulated
    contains 841510: Air conditioning machines; comprising a motor-driven fan and elements for changing the temperature and humidity, of a kind designed to be fixed to a window, wall, ceiling or floor, self-contained or split-system
    contains 841581: Air conditioning machines; containing a motor driven fan, other than window or wall types, incorporating a refrigerating unit and a valve for reversal of the cooling/heat cycle (reversible heat pumps)
    contains 841582: Air conditioning machines; containing a motor driven fan, other than window or wall types, incorporating a refrigerating unit
    contains 841590: Air conditioning machines; with motor driven fan and elements for temperature control, parts thereof
    contains 841583: Air conditioning machines; containing a motor driven fan, other than window or wall types, not incorporating a refrigerating unit
- 8414: Air or vacuum pumps, air or other gas compressors and fans; ventilating or recycling hoods incorporating a fan; gas-tight biological safety cabinets whether or not fitted with filters
    contains 841490: Pumps and compressors; parts, of air or vacuum pumps, air or other gas compressors and fans, ventilating or recycling hoods incorporating a fan
    contains 841440: Compressors; air compressors mounted on a wheeled chassis for towing
    contains 841480: Pumps and compressors; for air, vacuum or gas, n.e.c. in heading no. 8414
    contains 841420: Pumps; hand or foot-operated air pumps
- 8479: Machinery and mechanical appliances; having individual functions, n.e.c. in this chapter
    contains 847960: Machinery and mechanical appliances; evaporative air coolers
- 8418: Refrigerators, freezers and other refrigerating or freezing equipment, electric or other; heat pumps other than air conditioning machines of heading no. 8415
    contains 841861: Heat pumps; other than air conditioning machines of heading no. 8415
    contains 841810: Refrigerators and freezers; combined refrigerator-freezers, fitted with separate external doors, electric or other
    contains 841830: Freezers; of the chest type, not exceeding 800l capacity
    contains 841869: Refrigerating or freezing equipment; n.e.c. in heading no. 8418

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: A split-system air conditioner with a motor-driven fan and elements for changing temperature is expressly covered by heading 8415 (split-system machines under 841510 or 8415.81/82).
